name: Zenvora Pulse
summary: Omnichannel customer-engagement platform. One shared inbox for WhatsApp, email, SMS, web chat and voice, with automation, tagging and analytics for SMEs.
stack: Go; Python (FastAPI); PostgreSQL; Kafka; React; Flutter; AWS EKS
stats: 312 customers, about 2.3 million customer conversations per month (FY2025-26).

name: Zenvora Ledger
summary: Invoicing, GST e-invoicing, payment reconciliation and cash-flow forecasts for small businesses.
stats: 1,180 businesses on the platform; reconciles about INR 410 crore of payments per year.

name: Zenvora Care
summary: Managed customer-care service. Zenvora's trained agents answer customers on behalf of client brands, using Pulse as the work tool.
stack: Zenvora Pulse; Genesys Cloud; Jira Service Management
stats: 14 client brands, about 9,500 tickets per month, 93 percent CSAT in FY2025-26.
